name: Imouto Bloomers ~Houkago no Kuikomi Lesson~
original_name: いもうとブルマ～放課後のくいこみレッスン～
source:
Main character's father remarries leaving protagonist to live with three cute step sisters. Protagonist is going to know each sister better after classes in the gym.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
因父亲再婚，主人公开始与三位可爱的义妹同住一个屋檐下。每到放学后的体育馆里，他都会借机与每一位妹妹展开愈发亲密的“深入交流”。

[编修自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
